GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2017-12-14T04:29:00Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Left-joining single table multiple time with different conditions
Description: When trying to join a single table multiple times with different conditions, parameter values don't seem to be updated:

```js
        this.createQueryBuilder('claim')
            .select('claim.id')
            .leftJoin(ClaimHistory, 'repairerDelivery',
                '"repairerDelivery"."claimId" = claim.id AND "repairerDelivery".status = :status',
                { status: 80 })
            .leftJoin(ClaimHistory, 'buyerDelivery',
                '"buyerDelivery"."claimId" = claim.id AND "buyerDelivery".status = :status',
                { status: 100 })
            .where('claim."repairerId" = :id', { id: "1" })
            .getRawMany();
```

Gives this query

```sql
executing query:  SELECT "claim"."id" AS "claim_id" FROM "claim" "claim"
LEFT JOIN "claim_history" "repairerDelivery" ON "repairerDelivery"."claimId" = "claim"."id" AND "repairerDelivery".status = $1 
LEFT JOIN "claim_history" "buyerDelivery" ON "buyerDelivery"."claimId" = "claim"."id" AND "buyerDelivery".status = $2
WHERE claim."repairerId" = $3 -- PARAMETERS: [80,80,"1"] <---
```
Is this expected?
